# doit_user_notification (Data Source)

Personal notification config of a user, with the notification types the user is subscribed to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    doit = {
      source = "doitintl/doit"
    }
  }
}

variable "source_user_email" {
  type    = string
  default = "jane.doe@example.com"
}

variable "target_user_email" {
  type    = string
  default = "john.doe@example.com"
}

data "doit_users" "source" {
  email = var.source_user_email
}

data "doit_users" "target" {
  email = var.target_user_email
}

# A notification of the source user. Create it first, or use the ID of an
# existing one (see the doit_user_notifications data source to list them).
resource "doit_user_notification" "source" {
  user_id = data.doit_users.source.users[0].id
  name    = "Critical anomalies"

  settings = {
    cost_anomalies = {
      min_severity    = "critical"
      min_excess_cost = { amount = "500.00", currency = "USD" }
      allocations     = { mode = "all", ids = [] }
    }
  }
}

# Read one notification of a user by its ID.
data "doit_user_notification" "example" {
  user_id = doit_user_notification.source.user_id
  id      = doit_user_notification.source.id
}

# Give another user the same notification settings.
resource "doit_user_notification" "copy" {
  user_id  = data.doit_users.target.users[0].id
  name     = data.doit_user_notification.example.name
  settings = data.doit_user_notification.example.settings
}

output "notification_destinations" {
  value = data.doit_user_notification.example.destinations
}

output "copied_notification_id" {
  value = doit_user_notification.copy.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the notification config returned by create or list.
- `user_id` (String) The unique ID of the user. Must belong to the tenant resolved from the bearer token and optional `X-Tenant-Id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the config was created. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `destinations` (Attributes List) Server-managed destinations. Always one email entry with the target user's address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `etag` (String) Current strong ETag. Send it unchanged in `If-Match` on update or delete. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `name` (String) Display name of the notification config.
- `settings` (Attributes) The notification types the user is subscribed to, one attribute per type. A type the user is not subscribed to is null; an empty object (`{}`) means subscribed without options. An empty filter list means every value of that filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `update_time` (String) When the config was last changed. `null` only on a dry-run create.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Target user's email, copied by the server.
- `type` (String) Delivery channel. Personal delivery is email only.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies`

Read-Only:

- `allocations` (Attributes) Allocation scope for cost-anomaly notifications. `ids` are allocation ids from `GET
/analytics/v1/allocations`. An id outside the caller's tenant is rejected with `422` without saying
whether it exists elsewhere.

`mode: all` means every allocation with anomaly detection enabled, including anomalies that are not
tied to an allocation, and it carries an empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` require at least one
id. `mode: all` with a non-empty `ids`, and `include` or `exclude` with an empty `ids`, are rejected
with `422`. `ids` are an ordered list: the server stores and returns them in the order sent, and it does
not sort or drop entries. A duplicate id is rejected with `422`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations))
- `min_excess_cost` (Attributes) Minimum excess cost, as Money. Notify when excess cost is above this amount, not total spend.
`100.00` USD means $100. `currency` must be `USD`; any other currency is rejected with `422`. A
negative amount is rejected with `422`. A fractional amount is rejected with `422` (`100.99` is not a
whole number of dollars). `100` and `100.00` are both accepted. `0` and `0.00` are accepted. Amounts
above 1,000,000,000 whole dollars, and forms such as `Inf`, exponents, a leading `+`, or underscores,
are rejected with `422`. Responses return the amount as `"100.00"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost))
- `min_severity` (String) `warning` — warning and above. `critical` — critical only. There is no `information` or `all` value; a write of `all` is rejected with `422`. Clients may send only `warning` or `critical`. Responses return only `warning` or `critical`. A missing or empty stored severity (console "All severity levels") is returned as `warning`. `critical` is stored and returned as `critical`.
- `repeat` (Attributes) Resend controls for an active cost anomaly. Omit the whole `repeat` object when neither control is
set. An empty object is rejected with `422`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.allocations`

Read-Only:

- `ids` (List of String) Allocation ids, in the order sent. A read returns that same order. A duplicate id is rejected
with `422`. Empty when `mode` is `all`. Non-empty when `mode` is `include` or `exclude`.
- `mode` (String) `all` — every allocation with anomaly detection enabled (and unallocated anomalies). `include` — only the listed ids. `exclude` — all enabled allocations except the listed ids. `all` cannot be sent with a non-empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` cannot be sent with an empty `ids`.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.min_excess_cost`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat`

Read-Only:

- `every_hours` (Number) Resend until the anomaly is inactive, every N hours (1–24).
- `when_cost_grows` (Attributes) Resend when the anomaly's cost grows. At least one of `percentIncrease` or `minIncrease` is required.
An object with only `withinHours`, only `match`, or neither amount is rejected with `422`.

- both `percentIncrease` and `minIncrease` present → `match` is
  required (`or` or `and`)
- exactly one of `percentIncrease` or `minIncrease` present → omit
  `match` (percentage-only or value-only)
- neither amount present → rejected with `422`

`percentIncrease` is an integer percent (`10` means 10 percent) and must be at least 1. Omit
`withinHours` when the time window is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows`

Read-Only:

- `match` (String) How to combine percent and dollar growth when both are set. Required when both amounts are present; omit when only one amount is present.
- `min_increase` (Attributes) Minimum cost growth that triggers a resend, as Money. Must be a positive whole number of dollars.
`150.00` USD means $150. `currency` must be `USD`; any other currency is rejected with `422`. `0`,
`0.00`, and a negative amount are rejected with `422`. A fractional amount is rejected with `422`
(`150.99` is not a whole number of dollars). `150` and `150.00` are both accepted. Amounts above
1,000,000,000 whole dollars, and forms such as `Inf`, exponents, a leading `+`, or underscores, are
rejected with `422`. Responses return the amount as `"150.00"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase))
- `percent_increase` (Number) Minimum percent cost increase that triggers a resend. `10` means 10 percent. Must be greater than 0.
- `within_hours` (Number) Optional window in hours for the growth check (1–24).

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows.min_increase`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--insights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.insights`

Read-Only:

- `pillars` (List of String) Insight pillars. Empty or omitted means all pillars.
- `providers` (List of String) Insights provider ids such as `aws`, `gcp`, `azure`, `azure-ad`, `general`, `google-cloud-source`, `google-workspace`, `k8s`, `oci`, and `vmware`. These are the ids Insights resources use, not invoice platform ids such as `amazon-web-services`. Empty or omitted means all providers. Available ids depend on the tenant's connected accounts. Each value is a non-empty string.
- `severities` (List of String) Insight severities. Empty or omitted means all severities.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--new_invoices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.new_invoices`

Read-Only:

- `billing_profile_ids` (List of String) Billing-profile ids in this tenant, shaped like `ent_01HEXAMPLEBILLING0001`. This API does not list billing profiles, and `GET /billing/v1/invoices` does not return these ids. Empty or omitted means every billing profile in the tenant. A read of an omitted or empty list returns the field absent. An explicit list is returned in the order sent. A duplicate id is rejected with `422`.
